steps.en: Build NGINX with the module compiled in
steps.zh: 编译 NGINX，把模块编进去

steps.en: In the upload location, set where files land and which backend gets the request
steps.zh: 在上传 location 里指定文件落盘目录和接请求的后端

steps.en: Declare the fields that replace each file in the forwarded form
steps.zh: 声明转发表单里用哪些字段替代每个文件

steps.en: Parses the multipart body as it arrives and writes each file into upload_store
steps.zh: 边收边解析 multipart 请求体，把每个文件写进 upload_store

steps.en: Strips the file bytes, fills in name/type/path (plus md5/size) and passes the form on
steps.zh: 去掉文件字节，填上文件名、类型、路径（及 md5、大小），把表单转给后端

steps.en: Your backend reads the path field and moves or processes the file on disk
steps.zh: 后端读路径字段，直接搬走或处理磁盘上的文件

value.en: Slow multi-GB uploads are absorbed by NGINX; your app gets a small POST describing files already on disk
value.zh: 慢速大文件上传由 NGINX 接住，应用只收到一个描述已落盘文件的小 POST
